universes.name: Earth Prime
universes.subtitle: The Genesis of Logic
universes.description: The foundation world of the CodeVerse. Arithmetic engines are freezing and primitive data types are collapsing into corrupt bits.

levels.title: Variable Awakening
levels.story: The core energy matrix of Earth Prime has lost its calibrated metrics. You must declare the correct basic types and calculate the total defense output.
levels.prompt: Declare an `int energy = 100;`, a `double multiplier = 1.75;`, and calculate `double totalEnergy = energy * multiplier;`. Print `totalEnergy` to `cout`.
hints: Remember that double handles decimal points.
Use std::cout << totalEnergy;

levels.title: Arithmetic Resonance
levels.story: The magnetic relays require a harmonic average calculation. Given numbers, compute sum and remainder to stabilize the frequency.
levels.prompt: Write a program that takes two integers `a = 45` and `b = 7`, computes quotient `a / b` and remainder `a % b`, and prints them space-separated: `cout << quotient << " " << remainder << endl;`.
hints: Integer division truncates towards zero.
% operator computes the modulus remainder.

levels.title: Syntax Void Specter
levels.story: The Syntax Void Specter reigns over the corrupted planetary node. It corrupts logical expressions and flips boolean states. Defeat it by writing a boolean security validator!
levels.prompt: Write a program with `int shields = 85;` and `bool hasKey = true;`. If `shields >= 80 && hasKey`, print `ACCESS GRANTED: 100% SECURE`. Otherwise print `SECURITY BREACH`.
hints: Use && for logical AND.
Be exact with the output string.

universes.name: Function Nexus
universes.subtitle: The Grid of Subroutines
universes.description: A sprawling neon cyber-city where fractured functions cannot return their values and arrays leak across sector boundaries.

levels.title: Modular Pulse Function
levels.story: The power conduits in sector 4 need modular power amplification. Implement a standalone function `int amplify(int base, int factor)` that returns `base * factor + 10`.
levels.prompt: Create function `int amplify(int base, int factor)` returning `base * factor + 10`. In `main()`, call `amplify(12, 4)` and print the result.
hints: Ensure the function signature is placed before main.
Return base * factor + 10.

levels.title: Array Barrier Matrix
levels.story: The firewall contains a sequence of energy spikes. Write an algorithm to find the maximum value in an array `int spikes[5] = {14, 82, 33, 99, 45};` and print it.
levels.prompt: Iterate through the array `int spikes[5] = {14, 82, 33, 99, 45};`, determine the maximum number, and print `Max Spike: ` followed by the value.
hints: Initialize max with spikes[0] then iterate through 1..4.
Format must be 'Max Spike: 99'.

levels.title: Stack Overflow Golem
levels.story: The Stack Overflow Golem is dumping infinite frames onto the CPU cache! Defeat it by implementing a recursive factorial calculation with a secure base case.
levels.prompt: Write a recursive function `long long factorial(int n)`. If `n <= 1` return 1; else return `n * factorial(n - 1)`. In `main()`, print `factorial(6)`.
hints: Base condition stops the infinite loop.

universes.name: Object Realm
universes.subtitle: The Monoliths of OOP
universes.description: Gigantic crystalline constructs hover over vast architectural planes. Raw blueprints need encapsulation and parameterized instantiation.

levels.title: Class Guardian Blueprint
levels.story: Create the structural class for an orbital guardian unit. Encapsulate name and shield power.
levels.prompt: Define a class `Guardian` with private `string name` and `int power`. Provide a constructor `Guardian(string n, int p)` and a public method `void display()` that prints `Guardian: [name] | Power: [power]`. In `main()`, create `Guardian g("Aegis", 250);` and call `g.display();`.
hints: Use private access specifier for attributes.
Remember constructor initialization list or body.

levels.title: Destructor Protocol
levels.story: When objects go out of scope, automatic cleanup is vital to prevent realm corrosion.
levels.prompt: Create class `Resource` with a constructor that prints `Resource Allocated` and a destructor `~Resource()` that prints `Resource Deallocated`. In `main()`, create a block `{ Resource r; }` so both messages print in order.
hints: The tilde ~ denotes the destructor.
When the scope block closes, the destructor fires automatically.

levels.title: Rogue Object Colossus
levels.story: The Rogue Object Colossus was instantiated with corrupted parameters! Defeat it by writing a class with copy constructor and operator overload for object power merging.
levels.prompt: Create class `PowerCore` with `int energy;`. Implement a constructor `PowerCore(int e)` and overload `PowerCore operator+(const PowerCore& other)` returning a new PowerCore with summed energy. In `main()`, add two cores `PowerCore a(150); PowerCore b(200); PowerCore c = a + b;` and print `c.energy`.
hints: Return a new PowerCore from operator+.
Provide a getter getEnergy() const.

universes.name: Inheritance Kingdom
universes.subtitle: Lineage of Code
universes.description: An ancient citadel of code castles where base classes pass down sacred attributes to derived warrior subclasses.

levels.title: Ancestral Derivation
levels.story: Derive a specialized battle unit `Knight` from base class `Warrior`.
levels.prompt: Create base class `Warrior` with `protected: int basePower = 50;`. Derive `class Knight : public Warrior` with public method `void attack()` printing `Knight strikes with ` followed by `(basePower * 2)` and ` DMG!`.
hints: Protected members are accessible by derived classes.
Public inheritance syntax is: class Derived : public Base.

levels.title: Multi-Level Hierarchy
levels.story: Construct a 3-tier hierarchy: `Device` -> `Computer` -> `QuantumServer` with constructor chaining.
levels.prompt: Create `Device(string id)` -> `Computer(string id, int ram)` -> `QuantumServer(string id, int ram, int qubits)`. Method `void specs()` prints `Server: [id], RAM: [ram]GB, Qubits: [qubits]`.
hints: Pass parameters up the inheritance chain in constructors.
Device(i) -> Computer(i, r).

levels.title: Diamond Anomaly Chimera
levels.story: The infamous Diamond Problem Anomaly has spawned a multi-parent hybrid beast! Resolve ambiguity using virtual inheritance.
levels.prompt: Create base class `Node` with `int val = 42;`. Create `virtual public Node` for `LeftNode` and `RightNode`. Derive `class DiamondNode : public LeftNode, public RightNode`. In `main()`, create `DiamondNode dn;` and print `dn.val` without compile ambiguity.
hints: Use 'virtual public Node' on both LeftNode and RightNode.
Virtual base classes share a single instance.

universes.name: Polymorphism City
universes.subtitle: The Metamorphic Metropolis
universes.description: A shifting cyber-realm where data takes multiple shapes at runtime through virtual method tables (vtable) and dynamic dispatch.

levels.title: Virtual Spell Weaver
levels.story: The dynamic shield must dispatch attacks polymorphically based on actual runtime object type.
levels.prompt: Create base class `Spell` with `virtual void cast() { cout << "Generic Spell"; }`. Derive `FireSpell` overriding `cast()` to print `Flamestrike Burst!`. In `main()`, instantiate `Spell* s = new FireSpell(); s->cast(); delete s;`.
hints: Use the virtual keyword in the base class.
Override keyword is best practice in derived class.

levels.title: Pure Virtual Contract
levels.story: The dimensional portal interface is abstract. All portals must define `virtual void activate() = 0;`.
levels.prompt: Create abstract class `Portal` with pure virtual method `virtual void activate() = 0;`. Implement derived class `HyperlanePortal` printing `Hyperlane Jump Active: Sector 7`. Test via base pointer.
hints: = 0 makes the function pure virtual and class abstract.
Concrete class must override pure virtual functions.

levels.title: The Ambiguity Sovereign
levels.story: The Ambiguity Sovereign shapeshifts between multiple runtime forms. Use an array of polymorphic base pointers to execute a coordinated combo!
levels.prompt: Create base class `Hero` with `virtual void battleAction() = 0;`. Create `Mage` printing `Arcane Nova` and `Warrior` printing `Whirlwind Slash`. In `main()`, store pointers to both in an array `Hero* team[2]` and invoke `battleAction()` for each.
hints: Dynamic dispatch resolves each derived implementation at runtime.
Clean up with delete.

universes.name: Memory Dimension
universes.subtitle: The Heap & Pointer Abyss
universes.description: A dark quantum void where physical addresses, heap blocks, dereferencing stars, and dangling pointers collide.

levels.title: Address of Power
levels.story: Target the memory address directly using pointer dereferencing to multiply the plasma cannon charge.
levels.prompt: Create a function `void chargeCannon(int* plasmaPtr)` that modifies the value pointed to by multiplying it by 3. In `main()`, declare `int plasma = 40;`, call `chargeCannon(&plasma);`, and print `plasma`.
hints: Use *plasmaPtr to dereference and assign.
Pass address using &plasma.

levels.title: Dynamic Heap Array
levels.story: Allocate a dynamic memory buffer on the heap using `new[]`, populate it, compute its sum, and cleanly `delete[]` it.
levels.prompt: Allocate `int* buffer = new int[4];`. Assign values `10, 20, 30, 40`. Calculate the sum, deallocate with `delete[] buffer;`, and print `Heap Buffer Sum: ` followed by the sum.
hints: Always pair new[] with delete[] to prevent memory leaks.

levels.title: The Memory Leak Dragon
levels.story: The Memory Leak Dragon hoards gigabytes of orphaned heap blocks. Slay the dragon by writing a memory-safe Linked List Node with explicit destructor deallocation!
levels.prompt: Create a `struct Node { int data; Node* next; Node(int d) : data(d), next(nullptr) {} };`. Build a 2-node chain (values 50 -> 100). Print `Node 1: 50 -> Node 2: 100`. Deallocate both nodes safely.
hints: Connect head->next = new Node(100);
Delete tail node first, then head.

universes.name: STL Galaxy
universes.subtitle: The Standard Template Cosmos
universes.description: An infinite constellation governed by the Standard Template Library: dynamic vectors, hash maps, FIFO queues, and LIFO stacks.

levels.title: Vector Thrusters & Sort
levels.story: Calibrate the spacecraft vector array by pushing speeds and sorting them in ascending order with `std::sort`.
levels.prompt: Create `vector<int> speeds = {450, 120, 890, 310};`. Push `600` into the vector. Use `sort(speeds.begin(), speeds.end());`. Print elements space-separated on one line.
hints: Use speeds.push_back(600);
#include <algorithm> contains std::sort.

levels.title: Map Dimension Registry
levels.story: The dimension router maps universe IDs to planetary core frequencies using `std::map`.
levels.prompt: Create `map<string, int> planetCores;`. Insert `{"Earth", 100}`, `{"Nexus", 250}`, `{"Cosmos", 500}`. Lookup and print `planetCores["Cosmos"]` in format: `Cosmos Core Frequency: 500`.
hints: Use operator[] or insert for std::map.
Key is string, value is int.

levels.title: Unbounded Queue Hydra
levels.story: The Unbounded Queue Hydra floods the universe with a massive queue of asynchronous attacks! Process and exhaust its queue using `std::queue` FIFO discipline.
levels.prompt: Create `queue<string> hydraHeads;`. Push `"Fire Head"`, `"Ice Head"`, `"Toxic Head"`. While not empty, pop and print each head: `Defeated: [head]`. Finally print `Hydra Queue Cleared!`.
levels.expectedOutput:
Defeated: Fire Head
Defeated: Ice Head
Defeated: Toxic Head
Hydra Queue Cleared!
hints: Use front() to peek and pop() to remove.
Loop condition is while(!hydraHeads.empty()).

universes.name: Core Compiler
universes.subtitle: The Singularity of All Code
universes.topic: Grand Synthesis: Templates, Exceptions & Full OOP
universes.description: The epicenter of the entire CodeVerse. The Corrupted Null Root threatens to collapse all universes into undefined behavior.

levels.title: Generic Template Reactor
levels.story: Forge a universal generic template function `template <typename T> T maxEnergy(T a, T b)` that works across all dimensional particle types.
levels.prompt: Create template function `template <typename T> T maxEnergy(T a, T b)` returning the maximum. Test in `main()` with `maxEnergy<int>(150, 320)` and `maxEnergy<double>(4.5, 2.1)`. Print `Int Max: 320 | Double Max: 4.5`.
hints: Use template <typename T>.
T can be any comparable type.

levels.title: Exception Containment Vault
levels.story: Capture runtime division by zero anomalies with structured C++ `try`, `throw`, and `catch` blocks.
levels.prompt: Write a function `double safeDivide(double num, double den)` that throws `runtime_error("Division by zero detected!")` if `den == 0`. In `main()`, wrap a call `safeDivide(100, 0)` in a try-catch block and print `Caught Exception: ` followed by `e.what()`.
levels.expectedOutput: Caught Exception: Division by zero detected!
hints: Use throw runtime_error("..."); from <stdexcept>.
Catch by const std::exception& e.

levels.title: The Corrupted Null Root
levels.story: The Corrupted Null Root sits at the core of reality. Combine Classes, Inheritance, Polymorphism, Vectors, and Pointers into the Master Universe Restorer to purge corruption forever!
levels.prompt: Create an abstract class `UniverseModule` with `virtual string restore() = 0;`. Derive `MemoryCore` (returns `"Memory: Stable"`) and `LogicCore` (returns `"Logic: Purified"`). In `main()`, store pointers in `vector<UniverseModule*> system;`, iterate and print each result, and finally print `THE CODEVERSE IS RESTORED 100%!`.
levels.expectedOutput:
Memory: Stable
Logic: Purified
THE CODEVERSE IS RESTORED 100%!
hints: Derive both classes from UniverseModule with override restore().
Print each module's restore() output then the victory banner.
